subject: Staged ramp & pilot sweetener for FinOptima — MAP + procurement steps
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Kristen Wu <kristen.wu@finoptima.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: staged evaluation & ramp plan for FinOptima

Kristen —

Great to meet last week. As promised, I pulled together a pragmatic mutual action plan (MAP) so FinOptima can validate latency/cost on real workloads and we can align commercial terms for conversion. High level proposal:

- 60-day evaluation (we can do 30 -> 60 on request) with a $25,000 pilot credit applied to usage during the POC.
- Milestone 1 (week 2): integration & initial perf baseline (acceptance: < 150ms p95 on 2k concurrent callers).
- Milestone 2 (week 5): quality/accuracy checkpoint using your eval set; decide pilot success criteria.
- Milestone 3 (by day 60): conversion decision. If you convert within 30 days after acceptance, we apply a 15% conversion credit on the first 3 months of committed usage.

Commercial suggestions (open to discussion):
- Ramp ladder: commit $75k/quarter (Tier 1) => 10% discount; $150k/quarter => 15%; $300k/quarter => 20% and extended support.
- Pilot credit carries forward up to 60 days post-acceptance if you choose a committed term.

I attached a draft MAP spreadsheet and a light SOW describing deliverables and acceptance criteria (MAP_FinOptima_v2.xlsx, SOW_FinOptima_draft.pdf).

Next steps — can you confirm:
1) would you like the trial length extended to 60 days?
2) who on procurement should we include for PO/terms?

I can jump on a quick call with Sergio (commercial) and Neha (security) if you want to run through the acceptance criteria and SOC-2 evidence flow.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0123


From: Kristen Wu <kristen.wu@finoptima.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Adam Cole <adam.cole@finoptima.com>, Procurement <procurement@finoptima.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: staged evaluation & ramp plan for FinOptima

Thanks Olga — this looks solid and aligned with our internal timeline. A few quick asks from my side before we lock the MAP:

- Can you extend the evaluation to 60 days? We have a holiday week in the middle of April and need the extra runway.
- The pilot credit is helpful — can you confirm the $25k can be applied against a committed order if we convert?
- We need clarity on post-conversion unit pricing and whether the discount ladder you proposed is guaranteed for the contract term or only for the first three months.
- Procurement: procurement@finoptima.com is the right inbox. I’ve CC’d Adam (legal/business ops) — he’ll handle contract redlines.

Also: SOC-2 evidence is a hard requirement. Please loop Neha on the specific artifacts (audit report, subservice vendor list, log retention period).

If you can send a one-page MAP that calls out dates and the commercial breakout (credits, discount ladder, conversion incentive) I’ll share with our CIO.

Best,
Kristen Wu
VP, Data Products — FinOptima

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Kristen Wu <kristen.wu@finoptima.com>, Adam Cole <adam.cole@finoptima.com>, Procurement <procurement@finoptima.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: staged evaluation & ramp plan for FinOptima

Sergio / Neha — Kristen asked for a 60-day evaluation and clarity on pricing guarantees. Quick proposed commercial structure below that we can present as a single-page MAP:

1) Evaluation window: 60 days (starts on the date of environment access). Pilot credit: $25,000 applied to usage during eval. Credit rolls forward and offsets committed spend if they sign within 30 days of acceptance.

2) Conversion incentive: If FinOptima converts to a committed plan within 30 days of acceptance, apply a 15% one-time credit to the first quarter invoice (not stackable with other promotional credits).

3) Commit ladder (annualized):
   - Bronze: $75k/quarter (annualized $300k) — 10% list discount
   - Silver: $150k/quarter — 15% list discount + 2 tech-review hours/month
   - Gold: $300k/quarter — 20% list discount + priority scheduling and extended support SLA

4) Additional notes:
   - Net30 PO is OK, but procurement will need a signed SOW and MAP before we provision any dedicated support.
   - Security: Neha will share an artifacts checklist; SOC-2 report and data retention details will be provided via secure link.

I attached a cleaner SOW and a proposed one-page MAP for Kristen to take to her CIO (SOW_FinOptima_draft.pdf, MAP_FinOptima_v2.xlsx). Happy to adjust ladder numbers if you prefer different brackets.

Sergio — can you review commercial and confirm we can commit to the 15% conversion credit and the pilot credit roll-forward?

Thanks,
Olga

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Kristen Wu <kristen.wu@finoptima.com>, Adam Cole <adam.cole@finoptima.com>, Procurement <procurement@finoptima.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: staged evaluation & ramp plan for FinOptima — MAP v1 for signatures

Kristen — thanks for the quick feedback. Per Olga’s note, we’re happy to move forward with a 60-day evaluation and the commercial terms below. I’ve converted this into a formal MAP doc and included clear acceptance criteria so procurement has a single artefact to review. Key points:

- 60-day evaluation start: environment access date.
- Pilot credit: $25,000 applied to evaluation usage; carries forward up to 60 days after acceptance only if a committed contract is executed.
- Conversion credit: 15% credit applied to the first invoiced quarter if contract signed within 30 days of acceptance.
- Commit ladder (guaranteed for the first 12 months of contract): Bronze/Silver/Gold as discussed.
- Support: Gold tier includes 24/7 escalation and two dedicated incidents per year with reduced TTR.

Action items I’ve put in the MAP doc:
1) Tech enablement & perf baseline — FinOptima engineering team & Redwood runtime owners
2) Security review & SOC-2 evidence exchange — Neha to manage
3) Procurement & contract — Adam + procurement mailbox

Links: MAP (one-page): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1FinOptimaMAP
Signature: DocuSign -> https://www.docusign.net/FinOptima/MAP-signature

I also attached the draft SOW and included a pricing table with list rates and the proposed discounts for the ladder. If procurement has redlines, please send them back to this thread and we’ll route to legal.

Regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Sales — Enterprise Accounts, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com

From: Procurement <procurement@finoptima.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Kristen Wu <kristen.wu@finoptima.com>, Adam Cole <adam.cole@finoptima.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: FinOptima — redlines and PO process

Olga / Sergio / Neha —

Attached are our commercial redlines and standard purchase terms (FinOptima_Terms_Redline.docx). Major asks:
- Net30 is acceptable, but we need a 90-day mutual termination right for convenience.
- Liability cap: limit to 2x annual fees and carve out IP indemnities.
- Data retention: we require logs retained for 24 months for audit purposes.

Please confirm whether the pilot credit can be shown on invoice (we prefer an invoice line item) and whether the credit roll-forward can be detailed in the SOW. Also confirm how Redwood handles PO numbers and when we can expect the initial invoice (if any).

We’ll prepare a PO as soon as we receive a signed MAP and SOW that reflect these points or a statement about any non-negotiable terms.

Thanks,
FinOptima Procurement Team
procurement@finoptima.com
(Attachment: FinOptima_Terms_Redline.docx)

From: Kristen Wu <kristen.wu@finoptima.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinOptima — redlines and PO process

Olga / Sergio —

We reviewed internally and the team is happy to proceed with the MAP as drafted; procurement has sent redlines which are attached — please confirm which items are deal breakers. I initiated the DocuSign for the one-page MAP so you should see the signature request shortly. We will issue a PO within 10 business days after signature (Net30 payment).

A couple of clarifications:
- We want the pilot credit to appear as an invoice line item (fine if it’s shown as a negative line on the evaluation invoice).
- The 24-month log retention is a hard requirement for our audit team. Can Neha confirm feasibility?

Kristen Wu
VP, Data Products — FinOptima
(Attachment: MAP_Signed_excerpt.pdf)
